## Reference videos

- [Why “probability of 0” does not mean “impossible” | Probabilities of probabilities, part 2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZA4JkHKZM50) — 3Blue1Brown, English. **watch first**. Watch why a continuous density differs from the probability of a single point, exactly the foundation the lab needs when leaving discrete distributions.
- [The Beta distribution in 12 minutes!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=juF3r12nM5A) — Luis Serrano Academy, English. Watch the Beta distribution placed on an unknown probability; it supports the Bayesian inference part with continuous variables.
- [The Normal Distribution, Clearly Explained!!!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rzFX5NWojp0) — StatQuest with Josh Starmer, English. Watch the parameters of the Normal distribution; use it when the lab works with bell-shaped continuous models.
